summary.short: Brazilian statute creating PADIS, an incentive programme for semiconductor and display component makers (tax reductions, a minimum R&D investment of 5% of gross revenue, and a financial tax credit), and PATVD for digital-TV equipment (revoked 2024). It also protects integrated-circuit layout topographies. In force from publication, 31 May 2007.
summary.long: Lei 11.484/2007 establishes two industrial-policy programmes and a layout-design IP regime. PADIS (Chapter I) covers legal entities that invest in R&D and carry out listed semiconductor, display, photovoltaic-component and accumulator activities. Beneficiaries are approved by a specific Ministry of Science, Technology and Innovation act conditioned on tax compliance. Benefits include zero rates on PIS/Pasep, Cofins, IPI and import duty for qualifying purchases and imports, a 100% income-tax reduction on profits from device sales, and a financial tax credit tied to prior-quarter R&D spending. Beneficiaries must invest at least 5% of gross revenue in R&D, file annual reports with audit opinions, and face suspension or cancellation for breaches, plus a 20% fine and SELIC interest on unspent residual investment. PATVD (Chapter II) concerned digital-TV transmitters and is revoked by Lei 14.968/2024. Chapter III protects integrated-circuit layout topographies: INPI registration, ten-year protection, exclusive rights, compulsory licensing conditions, and a criminal offence of infringement. Chapter IV amends Lei 8.666/1993 to add a direct-procurement ground for high-complexity defence supplies. The text is a compiled version with many amendments; the operative provisions above reflect the amended wording shown.
